name: Vancouver
summary: Use Vancouver Local Areas as neighbourhoods. The property-tax-report dataset includes values and tax_levy, but tax_levy is the total notice amount, not a clean municipal-only levy reconstructed from mill rates.
privacy: Parcel-level property values, folios, addresses, legal descriptions, permit applicants/contractors, and postal-code fields are public but sensitive; aggregate before publishing.

boundaries.title: Local area boundary
boundaries.caveat: Only 22 Local Areas; coarser than Edmonton neighbourhoods.

assessment.title: Property tax report
assessment.caveat: No geometry; join land_coordinate to parcel tax_coord. tax_levy includes more than municipal general tax.

parcels.title: Property parcel polygons
parcels.caveat: Verify land_coordinate to tax_coord cardinality, especially strata/multi-folio records.

tax_rates.title: City tax-rate bylaws/pages
tax_rates.caveat: No clean open-data mill-rate table found; statutory reconstruction is complex.

transit.title: TransLink GTFS static feed
transit.caveat: Regional feed; filter stops/service to Vancouver boundary and confirm TransLink redistribution terms.

parking.title: Parking meters
parking.caveat: Curb paid parking, not an off-street public lot/parkade stall inventory.

population.title: Census local area profiles 2016
population.caveat: No 2021 Local Area profile found; derive 2021 by geospatial apportionment if needed.
